endorsements.quote: Governance requires both a named clinical service owner and a multidisciplinary institutional oversight function.

Governance should produce formal authorization, a named accountable owner, a version and change log, a monitoring protocol, and procedures for recalibration, restricted use, temporary suspension, and withdrawal.

unlisted_practices: Train intended users on the AI output, its limitations, required confirmatory actions, and when to escalate or override before deployment.
Do not deploy AI when input validity, calibration, transportability, subgroup safety, or actionable clinical utility is inadequate.
Specify how patient communication occurs when an AI result leads to testing, referral, or treatment discussion.
Delay deployment when the output recipient is unclear, confirmatory capacity is unavailable, or responsibility is fragmented across teams.
Evaluate decision thresholds in relation to downstream action and confirmatory-testing capacity rather than statistical convenience.
